description: Angular component for a dialog to create or edit CalculatedField objects, including form handling, validation, and interaction with services.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for a dialog to manage CalculatedField entities, including form setup, validation, and service interactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Saves the calculated field if the form is valid, then closes the dialog.

methods.name: onTestScript
methods.description: Tests the script expression using the form data and returns an observable of the result.

methods.name: changeEntity
methods.description: Updates entity name and ownerId based on selected entity.

methods.name: entityId
methods.description: Getter for the current entity ID, either from data or form.

methods.name: applyDialogData
methods.description: Initializes form with data passed to the dialog.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the entity is assigned to a customer based on customerId.
